findings.element: Running view, Shopify stores card: 'Setup · 5 of 5 done' summary above Review steps
findings.finding: The collapsed setup summary claims '5 of 5 done' even when step 4 was skipped with differences left or when a newly added store has re-opened step 2, while the expanded view of the same setup says 'Step 2 of 5 · 4 done'.
findings.user_impact: Users are told the job is finished when it is not (KF-2 drop-off pattern), so stock differences and misconfigured stores stay unfixed.
findings.suggested_fix: Derive the collapsed summary from the real step states, e.g. 'Setup · 4 of 5 done · 1 needs attention', and never show '5 of 5' while any step is open, skipped or needs a change.

evidence.action: Switch to '2 · Sync running', use '+ Connect another Shopify store' to add third-shop, pick Warehouse location, read the summary, then click Review steps
evidence.observed: Collapsed line reads 'Setup · 5 of 5 done'; expanded setup reads 'Step 2 of 5 · 4 done' with step 2 open ('third-shop (Shopify) … Non-inventory · Needs change') and step 4 'Skipped. 10 products still differ from QuickBooks'

findings.element: Running view attention line 'third-shop (Shopify) creates Non-inventory items' → Open Settings
findings.finding: The attention line only offers Open Settings with no Check again, and neither Open Settings nor Run now clears the line, so from the Overview the user has no way to confirm a fixed setting, unlike step 2 which offers Check again for the same problem.
findings.user_impact: A user who fixes the setting and returns still sees the warning and cannot clear it, so they loop back to Settings or assume the change did not work.
findings.suggested_fix: Show a Check again action on the attention line after Open Settings is used, same as step 2.

evidence.action: In '2 · Sync running', add third-shop, pick a location, click the attention line's Open Settings, then click Run now
evidence.observed: Toast 'Settings opened in a new tab.'; no Check again appears; after Run now the line 'third-shop (Shopify) creates Non-inventory items · Open Settings' is still present unchanged

findings.element: Step 2 'Track inventory in QuickBooks': Check again button
findings.finding: Check again is hidden until the user clicks Open Settings, so someone who already changed the setting has to trigger an unnecessary Settings tab before they can confirm and move on.
findings.user_impact: Users who fixed the setting beforehand, or via an already-open Settings tab, see no way forward from step 2 and may think they are stuck.
findings.suggested_fix: Show Check again from the start, next to Open Settings.

evidence.action: Open step 2 and look for Check again before clicking Open Settings, then click Open Settings
evidence.observed: Before: Check again present=false, only 'Open Settings' action; after click: toast 'Settings opened in a new tab.' and Check again appears

findings.element: Compare stock tab: Ignore row action, then Compare now
findings.finding: Clicking Ignore marks a row 'Ignored' and lowers the attention count, but the next Compare now silently reverts that row to 'Unresolved', so the decision does not stick and there is no undo on the ignored row.
findings.user_impact: Users who deliberately accept a difference must re-ignore it after every comparison, and the Overview's 'products differ' count creeps back up without explanation.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep Ignored rows as Ignored across comparisons unless the quantities change, and give ignored rows an Undo.

evidence.action: Compare stock: click Ignore on a row (Stone 13 / Stone 1), return to Overview, then click Compare now
evidence.observed: Row became 'Ignored · –' and attention fell from 10 to 9 products differ; after Compare now the state map shows 'Stone 13 … Unresolved · Set Shopify to QuickBooks Ignore' again

gaps: Check again 'setting still not changed' branch is not built, so the error/retry state of step 2 cannot be judged
Skip (step 4) not exercised in the state map; only its outcome ('Skipped. N products still differ') seen via V2 Review steps, not the step 4 → step 5 transition after skipping
Disconnect of a store (especially the last one) while sync is running not exercised, so whether stopping a live store needs confirmation or leaves a clear state is unknown
Held / Failed events: no data, so those counters' states and any recovery actions are unknown
Compare tab during setup says 'Run one with Compare now' but it is not recorded whether Compare now is actually available before sync is on
Open Settings and View in Shopify have no real target, so the return-from-Settings journey is only simulated
